columns.name: caller
columns.note: stable key of the member the call site is attributed to

columns.name: callee
columns.note: stable key of the target; always the ORIGINAL DEFINITION, never a constructed generic

columns.name: via
columns.note: 'lambda' when the call site sits inside an anonymous function; local functions are their own caller instead

columns.name: file
columns.note: call-site path relative to repo root

columns.name: tests
columns.note: 1 when the call site is in a tests/** project

columns.name: gen
columns.note: 1 when the call site is in source-generator output (Razor, LoggerMessage, Regex, OpenApi)

columns.name: ext
columns.note: 1 when the callee is declared outside the PetBox* assemblies

columns.name: constructed
columns.note: 1 when the call site used a constructed generic / reduced extension form

keyCaveats: Local functions have no documentation comment id; they are keyed 'L:<container doc-id>#<name>'.
Lambdas are never keyed: calls inside them are attributed to the enclosing member with via='lambda'.
Anonymous-type members DO return a doc id, but a containerless and therefore COLLIDING one ('M:.get_Key'). Treat keys matching '^[MPT]:\.' as unstable.

edgeKinds.description: non-virtual invocation; the callee symbol is the one that runs
property read; callee is the get accessor
attribute application; callee is the attribute constructor
property write; callee is the set accessor
invocation of a virtual/abstract/override member on a class; edge points at the DECLARED member
invocation through an interface member; edge points at the DECLARED interface member
overridden member -> the override; NOT a call site, a dispatch target
declared interface member -> its implementation; NOT a call site, a dispatch target
method named without invoking it (method group conversion / delegate creation)
synthesised: constructor with no initializer implicitly calls base()
same, at a non-invocation reference site
invocation through a delegate variable; callee is the delegate type's Invoke
